comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: The hold-pipe drain is skipped unless nudged (96b444d). The per-chunk poll is next, per the profile in the round report.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Measured in the vertical slice: a pane draining yes | head -c 30000000 takes 16 s in muster-daemon with no bridge, against 10 s for a bare PTY read loop. macOS PTY reads return about 3 bytes each under yes, so per-read overhead (poll, read, a pane lock per chunk, detection) dominates. Profile before changing anything; the latency targets are already met, so this is throughput under floods only.
title: The daemon's reader costs 1.6x a bare PTY read on a flood
